description.value: Western Canada's original craft distillery, Okanagan Spirits has been producing award-winning spirits from 100% BC grain and fruit since 2004. The Vernon flagship is a full-service destination featuring a tasting room, cocktail lounge, experience classroom, and drop-in tastings requiring no reservation. In 2025 the distillery earned the World-Class Distillery designation at the World Spirits Awards in Germany, taking home 11 Gold and 5 Silver medals across its whisky, gin, brandy, and liqueur portfolio.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM and website both confirm the Vernon flagship address as 5204 24th Street, Vernon, BC V1T 8X2. The contact page provides a phone number (1-250-549-3120) not present in OSM, and confirms the website URL. The website describes a full tasting room, cocktail lounge, and tours/experiences operation, confirming the business is active and open to walk-ins; however, none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are explicitly mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content.

Required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are not mentioned anywhere in the website content and cannot be confirmed without a site visit or direct inquiry.
